method: Every new proof body, including seven private generic helpers, public generic assembly, public actual-source consumer and three meaningful test proofs inspected. Minimal genuine parent definition/proof semantics inspected; compilation not performed by reviewer.

generic_private_helpers.name: rho_nonneg_and_gradient_growth
generic_private_helpers.argument: Actual C2 diagonal Hessian bounds feed genuine Hessian-to-strong-convexity and gradient Lipschitz producers with zero quadratic shift. First-order lower bound at rho(0)=0 and grad rho(0)=0 gives rho>=0. Gradient Lipschitz versus 0 gives norm grad rho(u)<=L norm u. No public convexity/Lipschitz certificate.

generic_private_helpers.name: weight_normalization
generic_private_helpers.argument: Continuous positive exp(-rho) bounded by 1 on the actual probability stdGaussian; domination gives L1. Nonzero probability and integral_exp_pos give strict positive actual Z; monotonicity gives Z<=1.

generic_private_helpers.name: density_calculus
generic_private_helpers.argument: Positive constant Z makes actual q=exp(-rho)/Z and f=exp(-rho/2)/sqrt Z well-defined. Chain rule produces C2 f, f^2=q, grad f=-(f/2) grad rho. Pointwise log q=-rho-log Z produces grad log q=-grad rho for this explicit smooth positive density, without differentiating an arbitrary AE RN representative.

generic_private_helpers.name: actual_standard_gaussian_gibbs_law
generic_private_helpers.argument: Pinned genuine isotropic Gaussian volume density at eta=1 gives gamma=volume.withDensity(ofReal(c exp(-norm^2/2))) with c>0. Actual probability mass and the Bochner withDensity formula give c integral w=1. Assuming w nonintegrable would make integral w=0 and contradict that mass identity; hence w L1 and integral w>0. This is a valid derivation of L1 from an independently proved probability mass, not a totalized-integral equality used as a fake analytic domain. The inverse partition coefficient yields the actual volume Gibbs law.

generic_private_helpers.name: actual_gaussian_tilt_volume
generic_private_helpers.argument: Actual base Gaussian Gibbs law and its established volume weight L1 satisfy the precise tilted_tilted parent prerequisite. Addition of exponents gives gamma.tilted(-rho)=volume.tilted(-(norm^2/2+rho)); current public positive Z separately rules out degenerate zero tilt.

generic_private_helpers.name: weighted_gradient_square_integrable
generic_private_helpers.argument: C2 makes actual gradient continuous. exp(-rho)<=1 and norm grad rho<=L norm u dominate exp(-rho) norm grad rho^2 by L^2 norm u^2; actual Gaussian norm-square L1 parent supplies the domain. Includes L=0.

generic_private_helpers.name: entropy_integrable
generic_private_helpers.argument: For rho>=0, 0<=rho exp(-rho)<=1 follows from rho<=exp rho. Thus rho exp(-rho) L1. q L1 already follows from the actual weight. Exact q log q=-Z^-1 rho exp(-rho)-log Z q yields actual entropy L1; no entropy assumption or logarithm at zero is used.

generic_public_assembly.probability: isProbabilityMeasure_tilted uses proved weight L1 and actual nonzero base probability. Actual q integrates to Z/Z=1 with Z>0. withDensity identity unfolds exact tilt.
generic_public_assembly.domains: Continuous f plus f^2=q L1 gives MemLp f 2. integrable_tilted_iff with established weight L1 and weighted gradient-square L1 gives grad rho L2 in actual r. Pointwise norm grad f^2=(4Z)^-1 exp(-rho) norm grad rho^2 gives L1 energy and continuous gradient f supplies L2.
generic_public_assembly.constant: Exact integral_tilted uses actual normalized weight; pointwise factor (4Z)^-1 gives integral_gamma norm grad f^2=(1/4) integral_r norm grad rho^2. Both nonnegative energies have actual L1 domains established before the equality.
generic_public_assembly.boundary_cases: Finite Hilbert dimension zero, L=0 and all finite L>=0 satisfy the same proof without division by L or dimension. No lower bound on L is hidden.

source_public_consumer.same_selector: Existing standardized_rgo_position_and_fisher produces a genuine measurable p satisfying p+eta grad V(p)=y. Its pointwise proximal producer is grounded in the contraction eta/(1+eta)<1 for all eta>0 and genuine strongly convex quadratic minimum.
source_public_consumer.same_laws: The exact same p defines rho, mu=volume.tilted(-V), R=mu.tilted(-norm(x-y)^2/(2eta)), and r=R.map((x-p)/sqrt eta). Parent actual affine Gibbs law is r=volume.tilted(-(norm u^2/2+rho(u))). This is composed with the generic actual volume Gaussian Gibbs identity to obtain r=gamma.tilted(-rho), and only genuine measure equality transports probability, L2 and energy.
source_public_consumer.internal_regularities: Parent computes actual rho C2, rho(0)=0, grad rho(0)=0, 0<=Hess rho<=eta. Set internal L:NNReal=eta using eta>0. All normalizer/positive density/entropy/L2/gradient/quarter conclusions then come from the generic producer. No supplied source probability, minimizer selector, density, integrability, LSI or Fisher certificate.
source_public_consumer.all_eta: Only eta>0 is required. Arbitrarily large positive eta is allowed; no neighboring numerical algorithm cap.
source_public_consumer.extension: S and measurable eta/y remain explicitly authored measurable-family lifting. Unit specialization recovers fixed printed parameters; no claim that this family formulation is itself separately printed.
